facts: FPCA publishes CORE Training for February 8–12, 2027 in South Florida on both its programme and upcoming-events pages.
CORE targets executive/administrative assistants to law-enforcement leaders and combines lectures, networking and hands-on training.
The 2027 programme page labels registration, biographical sketch and hotel information as coming soon and links an agenda from January 2026.
The linked January 28–30, 2026 draft includes classroom sessions, sponsored lunches and a networking hour; these are historical demand indicators only.
Amanda Dobson is Administrative Operations Manager and explicitly supports training/conference contract negotiations, banquet orders and purchase orders.
Waterstone is a Curio Collection by Hilton property at 999 East Camino Real in Boca Raton; Hilton lists 139 rooms.
Waterstone advertises classroom-capable meeting spaces; its wider events page lists full-service catering, high-speed internet and on-site audiovisual support.
uncertainties: Exact 2027 city, venue, hotel, CORE module structure and daily agenda remain unverified.
No evidence establishes that sourcing is open, Waterstone is shortlisted, a site visit is available or the property has space on the dates.
No verified attendance, room-night volume, budget, rate ceiling, catering commitment or revenue forecast.
Amanda’s event-specific ownership and final contracting authority are unverified; no CORE-specific procurement officer or agency travel coordinator was identified.
No published CORE-specific procurement requirements, contracting entity, approval chain or attendee payment arrangements were established.
Official hotel pages use different space totals and headline capacities; current classroom capacities, inventory, fees and accessibility allocations require a written proposal.
Individual LinkedIn profiles and direct personal telephone numbers were not verified. Published office channels are organisational routes, not personal lines.

facts: The 2026 Boca Internal Medicine Grand Rounds series spans January–December. Published sessions occur repeatedly on Tuesdays, 7:30–8:30 a.m., but the retrieved schedule does not establish an uninterrupted weekly cadence or a 2027 Grand Rounds schedule.

establishedFacts: The 2026 Boca Internal Medicine Grand Rounds series spans January–December. Published sessions occur repeatedly on Tuesdays, 7:30–8:30 a.m., but the retrieved schedule does not establish an uninterrupted weekly cadence or a 2027 Grand Rounds schedule.

Forthcoming Boca Grand Rounds listed as of the cutoff include November 10 and 17 and December 15, 2026, each 7:30–8:30 a.m. The November 10 detail page gives only United States as location; live CME accreditation is not proof of a physical Boca gathering.
Miami Neuroscience Symposium, 14th Annual: November 4–6, 2026, Hilton Miami Dadeland and Zoom. A forthcoming regional hybrid programme, not an unplaced Boca booking.

Hospital Medicine Symposium: detailed course page and upcoming-events calendar specify December 4, 2026 at Hilton Miami Dadeland; the symposium overview instead says December 3–4. Resolve this discrepancy before any outreach referencing dates.

2027 announced programmes include Precision Oncology, February 5–6 at JW Marriott Brickell; Palliative Care and Hospice, February 26 at Hilton Miami Dadeland; and Immunotherapies for Hematologic Malignancies, March 12–13 at JW Marriott Brickell.
Boca Raton Regional Hospital Internal Medicine Symposium is listed for March 19–21, 2027 as a virtual Zoom symposium; local branding is not evidence of physical hotel demand.

Marcus Neuroscience Institute Brain and Spine Symposium is announced in person at Renaissance Boca Raton, April 1–2, 2027. Magnetic Resonance in Radiation Therapy is listed April 5–7 at Loews Coral Gables; the 44th Annual Echocardiography and Structural Heart Symposium is listed September 23–25, 2027 at Loews Coral Gables.
Annual edition labels and the year-round Grand Rounds demonstrate recurring programming, not an annual Waterstone purchase commitment. Baptist publishes 12–18-month symposium development lead times.

Waterstone officially advertises full-service catering, meeting-space internet, dedicated on-site audiovisual support and indoor/outdoor venues. Hilton confirms 139 guestrooms and its Boca Raton address.
uncertainties: No verified Waterstone booking, RFP, overflow request, catering order, attendance forecast, budget or purchase frequency was found.
Published competitor venues establish announced placement, not the existence or terms of executed hotel contracts. Venue changes and any remaining ancillary opportunities require direct confirmation.
Grand Rounds physical venue/participation mode and outside-catering permission remain unverified; a virtual session alone produces no on-site F&B demand.

No named contact has verified hotel-contracting/signature authority. Individual programme assignments and current sourcing responsibility must be confirmed. Julie’s direct email is official; other outreach should use the departmental route rather than inferred personal addresses.

Waterstone official inventory is inconsistent: supplied context says four meeting rooms, the property marketing page describes five spaces, and Hilton lists ten meeting rooms. Hilton’s chart gives Atlantic Ballroom 192 classroom/320 theatre, while descriptive copy says a ballroom up to 225. Confirm usable indoor space, capacities and simultaneous-event constraints.
Hospital Medicine dates conflict across official pages: December 3–4 overview versus December 4 detailed course/calendar.

Most listed symposia are already assigned venues or virtual; no imminent, contestable local requirement has been established. Off-site satellite meetings, dinners and future cycles are sales hypotheses, not established demand.
